title: Rollout Heuristics & Handoff Checklist — Standup
content:
Standup notes — Rollout heuristics & handoff checklist
Date: 2027-10-23
Attendees: Marcus Li (owner), Aisha Banerjee, Sofia Delgado, Ethan Park, Calvin Moore
Context: preparing for panel-gating rollout for 2.1 UI surfaces and new analytics pipeline events. Goal is low-risk canary with clear rollback criteria and quick handoff to SRE/ops.

Summary / purpose:
- Capture the operational heuristics we want enforced for small-batch canaries (5% -> 20% -> 50%).
- Create a lightweight handoff packet for SRE/ops that includes runbook, telemetry quick-checks, and QA smoke steps.
- Confirm instrumentation gaps and who will patch them before the first canary window.

Pre-rollout checklist (owners):
1) Build & config
   - Feature flag gating implemented: console.feature.panel_gating v2 (PR merged) — owner: Marcus Li.
   - Canary routing policy set in infra: percent initial=5%, escalation steps= [5,20,50] with 30m cooldowns — owner: Calvin Moore.
   - Config snapshot & hash uploaded to release bucket — owner: Aisha.

2) Telemetry & observability
   - Events to surface: rollout.start, rollout.step, rollout.metric_snapshot, ui.render.latency, ui.error.rate, analytics.ingest.latency.
     - Missing: analytics.ingest.latency currently not emitted for panel-edges — owner: Sofia (action: add emission to kafka instrumentation by EOD 10/23).
   - Dashboards: quick dashboard created at https://observability.redwood/c/rollouts/metrics-312. Verify panels: 95pct latency, error rate (5m rolling), new-user-flow conversion. — owner: Ethan Park.
   - Alerts: error_rate > 0.8% sustained 5m OR latency P95 > 400ms => auto-rollback. Test alert firing on staging with synthetic traffic. — owner: SRE/Calvin.

3) QA / smoke tests
   - Smoke script steps (run locally or via terraform runner):
     a) Login as test-harness user -> open Panel A -> assert panel loads within 250ms (median).
     b) Trigger tool call (background job) -> assert event arrives in analytics topic within 10s.
     c) Toggle feature flag for test user -> verify client explainer modal appears.
   - Test owner: Aisha. Test completion target: 10/24 09:00 PT.

4) Rollout window & comms
   - Canary windows: 10/24 10:00-12:00 PT initial. Escalation windows 10/25 morning if green.
   - Primary on-call: Calvin Moore; secondary: Ethan Park.
   - Slack channel for live ops: #panel-rollouts (set topic to the rollout ticket). Pager duty escalation: PD-UI-Rollouts.

During rollout (runbook snippets):
- Before increasing %: check the following panels on dashboard: overall traffic, canary traffic, p95 latency, ui error rate, analytics ingestion lag.
- If alerts fire: mark canary paused, collect request traces for sample range, evaluate error types (client vs server vs infra).
- Rollback decision heuristic: if any of these hold true in the last 10m window -> rollback and open incident:
   * error_rate delta vs baseline > +0.6% absolute
   * p95 latency > baseline + 200ms absolute AND conversion drop > 3%
   * analytics ingestion lag > 30s sustained 
- Communication cadence: post status every 15m in #panel-rollouts; escalate verbally at first sign of SLO breach.

Post-rollout (validation & folks to ping):
- 1h post rollout: confirm conversion and error metrics stable; send short summary to product and pm@panel-team. Owner: Marcus.
- 24h health check: command-run to extract 24h windows and save artifacts to release bucket. Owner: Ethan.
- Retrospective notes: create lightweight retro doc in Confluence (CON-6821) regardless of success/failure. Owner: Sofia.

Open items / risks:
- Instrumentation gap for analytics.ingest.latency (Sofia to patch). Risk: if not fixed, rollback criteria rely more on UI-side metrics which might be noisier.
- Edge case: client-side A/B logic for panel gating differs for mobile web -> need validation on iOS/Android canary cohorts. Action: add mobile test cohort to canary config. Owner: Marcus.
- Observability retention: short-term retention limited for synthetic traces in #observability; ensure trace TTL bumped to 48h for the canary window. Owner: Calvin.

Action items (who / due):
- Sofia: add analytics.ingest.latency emit to panel-edge pipeline; PR + staging test by 2027-10-23 20:00.
- Aisha: complete smoke tests and attach results to the canary ticket (JIRA-8412) by 2027-10-24 09:00.
- Calvin: configure canary escalation policy in infra and verify alerts fire on staging by 2027-10-23 EOD.
- Ethan: finalize canary dashboard & add 3 quick links to Slack status message template by 2027-10-23 18:00.
- Marcus: prepare brief handoff note (5 bullets) for SRE before 10/24 window + merge final manifest.

Notes to self / meeting scraps:
- Keep handoff packet < 1 page. Ops hate reading long docs during rollouts.
- We should automate the smoke script to run from the runner pipeline and post results automatically to the rollout ticket. Follow-up: investigate runner job template next sprint.

Related artifacts referenced during meeting:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/3310 (panel gating adjustments)
- Confluence: CON-6821 (rollout runbook template)
- Jira: JIRA-8412 (canary orchestration)
- Observability dashboard: https://observability.redwood/c/rollouts/metrics-312

Next check-in: 2027-10-24 09:30 PT (pre-rollout sync)
